evidence.transport: Existing direct SDB session, package-name command workaround, temporary getter-only .NET helper.

attempts: The initial SDK attempt could not load the helper from /tmp; it exited before any native query and confirmed cleanup.
The same helper read every value successfully from the standard SDK staging folder. A host-side missing-file check then failed; a directory read verified cleanup without re-running the helper.
limits: The passive HTTP app-status query did not identify the visible app; uninterrupted film playback was not independently measured.
No app launch, remote key, playback control, Home/startup write, watcher pause or root acquisition was used.
This proves SDK-only native reads on this device and firmware. Native Home assignment, restore and boot remain untested.
The production home status and backup CLI still require explicit temporary root; SDK-only CLI integration is not part of this probe.
